purpose: Make the four-stage MSDS overwrite workflow explicit and optimize repeated work without weakening source, template or release gates.

business_stages.required_output: complete source inventory, readable source units, source hash and candidate fact ledger
normalized CN/EN semantic layers, reviewed field mapping, explicit disposition and traceability
fresh-clone DOCX with fixed template labels, sequence, geometry and approved value writes
audited DOCX with unsupported/empty rows hidden and visible numbering/order repaired

target_points.name: full_source_packet_reuse
target_points.goal: Extract every source unit once, bind reusable evidence to the original source hash and reuse only a matching packet.
acceptance: nested tables and non-table content are inventoried
cache key includes source bytes and extractor contract
cache miss or mismatch performs a fresh extraction

target_points.name: semantic_write_planning
target_points.goal: Resolve section-to-row payloads before clearing cells or changing table rows.
acceptance: S11/S12 alignment is planned by semantic endpoint
S9/S15 insertion capacity is planned before registry rebuild
fixed writes consume the reviewed plan rather than a shifting physical list

target_points.name: planned_post_overwrite_mutations
target_points.goal: Make row suppression, insertion and prefix-only renumbering a visible post-overwrite plan.
acceptance: structural changes are restricted to the active mutation boundary
empty or unsupported rows are suppressed before numbering
no whole-table rebuild or global soft-hide is introduced

target_points.name: diagnostic_gate_diffs
target_points.goal: Make contract failures actionable by reporting location, expected signature, actual signature, diff and remediation hint.
acceptance: format and locked-skeleton failures contain structured diagnostic fields
messages stay bounded and machine-readable enough for Harness logs
diagnostics never downgrade a blocker to a warning

target_points.name: stage_timing_and_fast_feedback
target_points.goal: Record low-overhead timing for the four stages and keep preflight/DOCX-only checkpoints available for iteration.
acceptance: timing is emitted in matrix-report.json and progress events
preflight-only and no-pdf remain cheap diagnostic modes
fast checks never replace final DOCX/PDF/render QA

target_points.name: evidence_safe_reuse
target_points.goal: Reuse product or ontology knowledge only as a reviewed candidate validator, never as an automatic source substitute.
acceptance: derived values retain provenance and disposition
conflicting or ambiguous candidates block release

non_goals: Do not change locked labels, sequence wording, boldness, typography, geometry, merges, headers or footers.
Do not auto-fill blanks from a knowledge base, product memory or model confidence.
Do not use wholesale w:hidden soft-hiding, global template sanitization or table reconstruction in production.
Do not skip final semantic, locked-format, whitespace, geometry, source-traceability or render gates.
Do not promise a fixed wall-clock duration before collecting comparable stage telemetry.
release_blockers: business stages are executed out of order
source extraction is incomplete or source evidence is reused across a hash mismatch
semantic normalization is mixed into physical template writes without a reviewed mapping
fixed template structure is changed outside the active mutation boundary
post-overwrite row mutation leaves empty rows, blank paragraphs or discontinuous visible numbering
diagnostic improvements hide or downgrade a failed gate
timing or fast feedback controls are used to bypass final release QA
